_v24: A preset-less checkpoint must change nothing the previous checkpoint left, so it is compared with the state after preset_on, not the pre-run baseline: preset restore is a v2.4 seed (06 record), so the applied preset legitimately stays. That comparison was only right on a backend where the preset was refused. On a Text Completion backend the old fixture failed AND left the install's sampler on the probe preset, and the run-header diff did not see it (the header records no preset). The restore step puts the install back and fails if it cannot.
_x20: v2.4 plan 06 (X20): a checkpoint preset is a per-request sampler overlay, never an install write (effectsApplier.armOverlay, samplerOverlay.ts; .claude/rules/architecture.md 'A preset is a per-request sampler overlay'). The T7 suite (2026-10-03) failed this fixture on 'preset Artemis v1.1 RP != Story: SO Preset Probe; temp 1 != 0.42', which is the old install-write expectation. It now asserts, on Text Completion AND Chat Completion: an applied ledger row naming the preset, the overlay armed in the snapshot keyed by the open chat + preset_on with temperature/top_p 0.42, and the install sampler (TC preset/temp/top_p, CC preset/temp) UNCHANGED as the negative control; on any other API a failed row with the overlay reason and nothing armed. Leaving for preset_off disarms the overlay and arms nothing. Whether the overlay reaches a loud request is jest's (samplerOverlayEffect.test.ts): this row makes no generation.
